parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The input content type, which can be video or image.

- 0: indicates a video URL or Base64-encoded video string.

- 1: indicates an image URL or Base64-encoded image string.

- Other values: invalid input.

sub_parameters.name: URL
sub_parameters.description: The image URL to input when Type is set to 1. **You must input exactly 4 images, and the 4 images should be uniformly sampled from a 2-second video. The resolution and number of channels must be consistent.** We recommend that you use an China (Shanghai) region OSS URL. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS region other than China (Shanghai), see [File URL Processing](~~155645~~).

sub_parameters.name: imageData
sub_parameters.description: The Base64-encoded image string. When both this parameter and URL are specified, URL takes priority. For information about Base64 encoding, see [File Base64 Processing](~~468191~~).

parameters.name: VideoData
parameters.description: The Base64-encoded video string. When both this parameter and VideoURL are specified, VideoURL takes priority. For information about Base64 encoding, see [File Base64 Processing](~~468191~~).

parameters.name: VideoUrl
parameters.description: The video URL to input when Type is set to 0. We recommend that you use an China (Shanghai) region OSS URL. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS region other than China (Shanghai), see [File URL Processing](~~155645~~).
